source.extractor: simulation/cad/extract_geometry.py (OCCT/OCP XCAF reader, world-placed bounding boxes and ray casts)

frame.vertical_axis: +Y (the floor plate 'Surface anti derapante' is thinnest along Y)
frame.arm_direction: +Z (the 'Profile Polyester' beams are longest along Z); +Z is the capsule/outboard side

rotation_axis.note: shaft bbox [-22.5, -45.0, -22.5, 22.5, 371.0, 22.5] mm; every bearing/brake-disc centre within 0.000 mm of it

gearmotor.note: SEW KA37 DRS71S4, sits under the hub on the axis

arm.note: two polyester beams, X = +/-150 mm, span Z -1160..1840 mm. The product is NAMED '4000mm' but the modelled length is 3000 mm: check which is built.

capsule.orientation_inference: The occupant LIES in the capsule along the arm (it is 2.8 m long, 0.9 m wide, 0.2 m deep). The raised canopy covers the inboard end (over the axis), so the head is inferred to be inboard and the feet outboard. Inference from shape only: LOW-MEDIUM confidence.

rider.note: No person is modelled in this STEP (no product named like a body/mannequin; the only 'Dummy' parts are a brake and a bearing block). Every rider position below is a PARAMETER, not a measurement.

leg_tip_radius_m.from: capsule far (outboard) wall, inner surface, max over heights above the floor
leg_tip_radius_m.note: The farthest any part of a person inside the capsule can be from the axis: the soles/toes pressed against the far wall. Conservative for g: the real toe radius is this or less.

leg_tip_radius_stature_estimate_m.from: head crown against the inboard (near) wall at 0.328 m on the far side of the axis, plus an ASSUMED stature of 1.75 m

reference_radius_m.from: NOT from the CAD. ARM_RADIUS_M=1.5 is the radius raspberry-pi/ tests and the console use as 'axis to occupant' (where the runtime quotes g and applies the g-dot limit). There is no seat in this CAD: the occupant lies down, so 'seat radius' has no single CAD value.

confidence.capsule_walls: HIGH (ray casts on the capsule solid)
confidence.leg_tip_radius: UPPER BOUND ONLY - the rider is not in the CAD
